title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Detour With You〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you!
I'm An Shiraishi. You can call me An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, did I startle you? Sorry about that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I just wanted to get to know you since we're classmates and all!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (An's been such a good friend to me this past year... I want to pay her back somehow.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The only thing is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I started trying to make an easy-to-read notebook to help An study...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's taking more brain power than I expected to perfect the layout.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's already tiring enough to write by hand!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Maybe I should just type it up? I'd be done a lot quicker that way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But writing by hand is helping organize my thoughts, and it's going to make it easier to teach An tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Oh well. I already got this far, so I guess I'll stick to making it by hand.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, this part here has a lot of similar words bunched up together. It's already complicated, so it'll be bamboozling for someone who understands none of it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll use colored pens and markers to break it up and... Whoa, that made it so much easier to read!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's turning out so cute! I gotta keep this up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's just no way to explain this part in simple terms. If I simplify it any more, I'll be changing the meaning...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I might have to give up on this one. For now, I guess I'll make some tea and work on an illustration...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Urgh, the text looks skewed to one side like this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I could swap the sections around... It wouldn't match the order of the textbook anymore, but it'd look better visually.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright! On this occasion I'm prioritizing aesthetics!
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
I'm getting sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, it's only 3:30 a.m.?! I never get sleepy this early.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Though, I guess it makes sense. I actually went to school and even studied after classes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The others are probably asleep now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, speaking of school, I should probably go to bed soon...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But the notebook's nearly done, so why don't I make some coffee and keep going for a while longer?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, a message. Who could that be?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Is anyone up still?>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <I'm working on something. I just got the urge.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: One from Enanan too. Looks like the rest of N25 are all up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, I guess this is our usual peak time for deep concentration.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Looks like it's business as usual. Oh, I'd better reply.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <I'm up, but I'll be asking for trouble if I don't sleep soon.>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <Wait, you're still up, Amia? Don't you have school again tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <I was wondering about that. Is it okay for you to be up when you still have school tomorrow?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Aren't you going to sleep?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <I'm working on something to prepare for my supplementary class tomorrow. I can't sleep until it's finished. Woe is me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <You have only yourself to blame for being put in those classes. I'm sure you'll be fine, but I won't let you live it down if you get held back.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Message
rows.Line: <Well done for working so hard, Amia. Just don't fall asleep at school.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <I can't make any promises.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Argh, what am I doing? I've gotta stop dawdling and get back to work!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahh! It's done!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's nearly morning! That took longer than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm barely gonna get any sleep in. Hmm... I could skip the morning?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I guess that's not an option right now. I don't want to draw attention to myself while I'm already taking supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll just message the others before I go to bed. “Good night!” Okay, now let's hit the hay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wonder how An's gonna react when I give her this notebook... I hope she likes it.)
